title: Release gate + cross-system capability comparison (XBOW / PentestGPT / PentAGI / OWASP Nettacker)
goal: Per Codex Layer 5 + Codex success criterion: 'zonder metriek geen beter'. Formal release-gate that evaluates AegisPT (post-foundation sprint) against XBOW score, PentestGPT capabilities (from public benchmarks), PentAGI features, OWASP Nettacker scanner coverage. Deliverable is gate-decision report + go/no-go for parity sprint.
scope: (1) Re-run XBOW benchmark with full foundation stack (407-417). (2) Capture: XBOW solved %, exec_plan_successful avg, chain_findings avg, verified-exploited ratio, time-to-first-proof, cost per confirmed finding. (3) Compare against published numbers: XBOW 84.6%, PentestGPT (varies), PentAGI (architecture comparison). (4) Compare scanner coverage vs OWASP Nettacker module list. (5) Report at docs/validation/release-gate-mythos-exploitation-foundation.md with GO/NO-GO + specific gap-items.
generation_reason: Per Codex: 'Dit voorkomt dat we weer DONE zeggen zonder echte delta'. Foundation sprint close requires quantitative gate, not narrative claim. Per ANTI_DRIFT.md Rule 1: this IS the user-value metric ritual.

constraints.active_task_gate: Single active task AND ANTI_DRIFT.md loaded.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Gate evaluation + report only. NO new capability code.
constraints.phased_targets: Foundation close target: XBOW ≥30%. Parity close target: ≥50%. Iteration milestones: 70%, 80%+.
constraints.no_self_grading: Comparison uses published numbers (XBOW 84.6%, PentestGPT bench), not self-reported.

success_criteria: Metric: XBOW re-run score ≥30% (foundation close target).
Per-metric comparison vs XBOW, PentestGPT, PentAGI, Nettacker.
GO/NO-GO decision for parity sprint backlog-420 + 421.
All ANTI_DRIFT pre-commit checklists from 407-417 verified in DONE_LOG entries (audit step).
must_not_touch: Production code (gate is evaluation, not implementation)

acceptance_criteria: DONE_LOG audit shows ANTI_DRIFT checklist filled in for 407-417.

after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md sprint close entry: 'mythos-exploitation-foundation closed' + XBOW score + comparison summary + pre-commit checklist per ANTI_DRIFT.md.
If GO: promote backlog-420 (parity sprint begins) into NEXT_TASK.md.
If NO-GO: surface to operator with specific failure-mode summary; halt sprint progression.
